answer: An agent economy resists sybils by making identity expensive to fake and cheap to check. Each newcomer must grow along a work vine: only answers that peers recompute and countersign count as real attachment points. Independent miners then mirror the same pending transaction and attest solely when their local replay matches the claim, collapsing clone farms that cannot reproduce the work. The resulting locked-stake history is the anchor that gates reward payouts and grading seats, so unbacked keys stay outside settlement.
